definitions.name: the opt-in live harness warms once, routes every case, and reports only metadata
the live harness fails honestly when native answers collapse to Sonnet or become fallbacks
duplicate live cases still perform native evaluations instead of passing from the router cache

assertions.expression: assert.equal(report.passed, false, 'Two Haiku decisions alone do not establish all-tier coverage')

definitions.name: live preflight never unloads another resident model or downloads a missing selected model

assertions.expression: assert.rejects(runRoutingTests(config, { fetchImpl: busy.fetchImpl, write: () => {}, cases }), /Other Ollama models are resident/)
assert.rejects(runRoutingTests(config, { fetchImpl: missing.fetchImpl, write: () => {}, cases }), error => error.code === 'OLLAMA_MODEL_MISSING')

helper_assertions.expression: assert.equal(path, '/v1/systemone', 'No downloads, unloads, Jev, chat or Anthropic calls are allowed')
assert.ok(choice, 'The actual human task must survive Claude-shaped background')

adaptations: Only timestamp,warmup_ms,row latency_ms and final progress duration are projected after validation; raw observations remain separately retained. No timing qualification.
Native accepts fixture bytes rather than cases plus optional fixtureHash. Preserve supplied/omitted hash tags; independently verify native digest of exact input bytes.
Fetch redirect:error/AbortSignal are Node API properties; native owned transport does not follow redirects. All actual request headers,URL,method and body remain compared.
Native typed error identity must preserve source code/message. Generic JS Error stack/prototype is outside Rust API.
No live evaluator, provider, model download, configuration write or numerical benchmark is executed.
